## What changed

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue, if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Explain checks that were not run and why.
For gameplay changes, include fighter choices and reproduction or replay steps.
For visual changes, include before/after screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change fits the scope in the roadmap.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation have been updated.
- [ ] Extracted facts and reconstructed behavior are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] No credentials, game images, playable exports or local build output are included.
